cases.logout_access: Anonymous pages redirect to login; private API refuses anonymous read
cases.final_gate_logs: Final readiness/manual mode, closed AI review gates and Render log review

owner_acceptance.render_logs_evidence: Owner-confirmed review, raw logs not collected
